title: ARV Asset
description: A video asset. id MUST be unique within the publishing origin. Vendor data MUST live under extensions with a reverse-domain key.

arv.description: ARV version. Every ARV object carries "arv": "1.0".

language.description: The main spoken language as a BCP 47 language tag (RFC 5646), for example en or de-AT. The same value as schema.org inLanguage. Omit it when unknown.

caption_languages.description: BCP 47 tags of the caption or subtitle tracks the origin offers. The same list as schema.org subtitleLanguage. An origin's own transcript is not a caption track.

extensions.description: Vendor data keyed by reverse domain, for example "com.mux".

modified_at.description: When anything public about the asset last changed (title, description, moments, transcript, rights, availability). RFC 3339 in UTC. Never moves backwards.
